result.summary: Authored two new evidence-scope files only: a self-contained diagnostic test suite (retired-state-probe.gd) that decodes Construction.state_bytes() via an explicitly declared 18-segment serialization-order table (matching the literal source append order, not §4.1 ordinal order), measuring each segment's expected byte length at runtime with var_to_bytes() over a zeroed prototype of the exact packed type/extent (no hardcoded header/offset constants), asserting total observed length equals the sum of measured segment lengths before any slicing, and decoding each slice with bytes_to_var() with an explicit Variant-type and count check per segment. It captures each project's public row identity from the OpResult.value returned by open_build(), runs the three specified real histories (dirt_path BUILD to commit, open_stockpile BUILD cancelled pre-delivery, open_stockpile BUILD delivered+begun+1mwu then cancelled) on fresh per-test Construction/Buildings stores from before_each(), asserts every .ok on each operation, asserts the public handle refuses post-retirement while decoding the retained row's 16 scalar fields plus its 4 delivered-material cells and the store's live_count against the exact expected residual values given in the task, and adds one dedicated corruption-witness test that truncates/extends a valid snapshot by one byte and asserts the decoder's length check refuses before any slice/decode/index occurs. A second minimal focus runner (retired-state-probe-focus.gd) extends test/run_tests.gd and overrides only _discover_suites() to return exactly res://test/construction_retired_probe.gd, inheriting the existing worker/supervisor/abort-detection machinery unchanged and running no other suite. No production files, validators, save-format code, or hardcoded Variant-encoding constants were introduced; all Construction/Buildings/Catalog/IntMath API calls used are the ones already present in the supplied source files.

extends "res://test/run_tests.gd"
## Runner focus: restrict suite discovery to the retired-state probe only.
##
## No inherited old tests. `_discover_suites()` is the only override: it returns exactly one
## path, `res://test/construction_retired_probe.gd`, which the dispatching harness places there
## as an owned clone of this evidence packet's `retired-state-probe.gd`. Everything else --
## the worker/supervisor split, the marker protocol, the abort detection described in
## `run_tests.gd`'s own header -- is inherited unchanged from the base runner.

const FOCUS_SUITE_PATH: String = "res://test/construction_retired_probe.gd"


func _discover_suites() -> PackedStringArray:
	"""Return only the one suite this focus exists to run."""
	var paths: PackedStringArray = PackedStringArray()
	paths.append(FOCUS_SUITE_PATH)
	return paths
